title: Sumant Sinha on Figuring Out with Raj Shamani
summary: ReNew's Founder, Chairman & CEO Sumant Sinha joins Raj Shamani on Figuring Out to explain what makes India's power grid unique, and why our approach to infrastructure has more strengths than we often give it credit for.
